visual_action: A person stands on a stage in front of a massive beige curtain. The person pulls the curtain open, revealing a screenshot of an online store's product page for a white t-shirt. The t-shirt has a stylized blue image of Joe Biden with glowing red eyes, with '20' and '24' on either side of his head. The product page shows options for size and quantity.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: An image of Joe Biden with glowing red eyes is featured prominently on the t-shirt that is the subject of the video.

on_screen_text.text: when my friends ask me what I bought for my summer wardrobe

spoken_summary: A female voice sings "Lights, camera, action," interspersed with camera shutter sound effects.
audio_music: The video features the song "Light Camera Action" by Davi Richie. It's an upbeat, electronic track that starts with a siren sound and builds hype for the reveal with the lyrics and camera shutter sounds.
editing_pacing: The video is a single shot used as a meme template. A digital image is superimposed and revealed as a person pulls back a physical curtain, creating a dramatic reveal effect.
manipulation_or_satire: The image of Joe Biden on the t-shirt has been digitally altered to have glowing red eyes, a reference to the 'Dark Brandon' meme. The video itself is a composite, with a screenshot of a product page digitally inserted behind the footage of the person opening the curtain.
cultural_references: The video uses the 'man opening curtain on stage' meme format to reveal something.
The depiction of Joe Biden with glowing red eyes is a direct reference to the 'Dark Brandon' internet meme.
central_claim: The best addition to a summer wardrobe is merchandise supporting Joe Biden's 2024 campaign, specifically items referencing the 'Dark Brandon' meme.
intended_effect: To amuse viewers, foster a sense of in-group pride among supporters familiar with the 'Dark Brandon' meme, and encourage the purchase of campaign merchandise.
